title.narrative: Support to INL Intervention in Burkina Faso, Niger and Senegal

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Project is to allow targeted security administrations in Burkina Faso, Niger and Senegal to become more efficient in their day-to-day activities.
More specifically, the project aims to:
- procure equipment for targeted law enforcement institutions in Burkina Faso, Niger and Senegal in order to increase their operational capacities; and
- strengthen the security and improve the working conditions through renovation works at the Ouagadougou High Security Prison.
